sdcc.name: SDCC
sdcc.license: GPL-2.0-or-later, library with a linking exception
sdcc.description: The Small Device C Compiler, a retargetable optimizing C compiler for 8-bit processors. Its Z80 family ports cover the Z80, Z180, Z80N, R800, eZ80 in Z80 mode, the Rabbits, the TLCS-90 and the Game Boy's SM83.
sdcc.language: C90, C99, C11, C17, part of C23, part of C2y

llvm-z80.name: llvm-z80
llvm-z80.description: A fork of LLVM, the open-source compiler infrastructure behind Clang, with backends for the Z80 and the Game Boy's SM83.
llvm-z80.language: C89, C99, C11, C17, C23, part of C2y

80cc.name: 80cc
80cc.description: z88dk's newer compiler: the Small C frontend it shares with sccz80, and a new backend that lowers an SSA-style intermediate representation to Z80 family assembly.

zsdcc.name: zsdcc
zsdcc.description: SDCC as z88dk builds it: SDCC with z88dk's patches and peephole rules, driven by zcc and linked with z88dk's z80asm, C libraries and startup code for over a hundred Z80 machines.
zsdcc.language: C90, C99, C11, C17, part of C23, part of C2y

sccz80.name: sccz80
sccz80.description: z88dk's own compiler, descended from Ron Cain's Small C of 1980 through James Hendrix's Small C and decades of z88dk work, now close to C90 with extensions.

ez80-clang.name: ez80-clang
ez80-clang.description: CE-Programming's fork of LLVM for the eZ80 in TI calculators, which also compiles for the Z80. CEdev's runtime is for the eZ80's ADL mode only, so here it is built with z88dk's headers and linked with z88dk's runtime and C library, the way z88dk uses it.
ez80-clang.language: C89, C99, C11, C17, C23, part of C2y

fcc.name: fcc
fcc.description: The Fuzix Compiler Kit: Alan Cox's C compiler for 8-bit processors, written to build the Fuzix operating system for the 8080, 8085 and Z80.

hitech.name: HI-TECH C
hitech.license: Free for any use, copyright HI-TECH Software
hitech.description: HI-TECH Software's C compiler for CP/M-80 from the late 1980s, later released free, with fixes kept up by Tony Nicholson. It runs here under the zxcc CP/M emulator and its programs as CP/M programs.

uc80.name: uc80
uc80.description: A C compiler for the Z80 and CP/M written in Python, which compiles a whole program at once and optimizes for size.

dcc.name: dcc
dcc.description: David Lee's C compiler for CP/M on the Z80, with its own peephole optimizer, Z80 runtime and clones of Microsoft's M80 assembler and L80 linker. It compiles a program from one C file.
dcc.language: C89, part of C99, part of C11

gb-llvm.name: gb-llvm
gb-llvm.description: A fork of LLVM with a backend for the Game Boy's SM83.
gb-llvm.language: C89, C99, C11, C17, C23, part of C2y
